name: @pipeworx/mcp-uuid

tools.name: validate_uuid
tools.description: Validate and parse a UUID (keyless, offline): checks the format and returns the version (1-8), variant, whether it is nil/max, and — for time-based versions (v1, v7) — the embedded timestamp as an ISO date.

tools.name: generate_uuid
tools.description: Generate one or more random v4 UUIDs.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-uuid forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the uuid pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
